title: Transfer funds between a member's shares
description: Sign on, open a member record, move an amount between two shares with a memo, review and post.
goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE using the Operator ID, Password and Branch supplied. From the main menu choose Member Inquiry / Selection, set 'Search by' to Member Number, enter the member number and press Search, then select the result. On the MEMBER RECORD screen use the Funds Transfer action. Choose the from-share and the to-share, enter the amount and the memo, continue to the review screen, verify the review details, and post the transfer. The hidden _token belongs to each live form: never copy or persist it; submit the live form normally so the browser carries the current token. Read the confirmation reference and posted amount from the result screen.

inputs.name: from_share
inputs.description: Share ID to debit, exactly as printed in the SHARES / BALANCES table. A share on HOLD cannot be debited.

outputs.name: confirmation_reference
outputs.description: Reference the console issues once the transfer is posted.
